checks: Opaque sandbox readiness, initial state, canonical CSS
Four exact presets at 0%,25%,50%,75%,100%; sample, markers, lead, pressed state and CSS
Custom crossing coordinates and valid rounded atomic apply
Invalid blank, NaN-like, range and duration inputs retain committed math/export and text
Pending edits leave animation and committed output alone; preset/reset replace fields
Keyboard .01/Shift .1 increments, clamps, focus, unrelated key default
Real mouse drag rounds and clamps with pointer capture and release
Secondary mouse button, secondary pointer and different-pointer move ignored; cancel/lost capture terminate
Hidden-document branch pauses and returning visible remains paused (injected visibility)
Reduced-motion dynamic and initial disable play/replay while permitting scrub and reset
Injected clipboard API success, rejection fallback success, false/throw failure, selection
320,375,768,1024,1440,1600 widths and 200% root text have no horizontal overflow; fields/handles stay inside viewport
Touch emulation uses real CDP touch events with capture and same bounds
No script errors and zero network requests across browser suite
repairs: Browser math check repaired negative-zero lead display by rounding before choosing sign.
Code inspection before browser run: capture timeline input before pause() rerenders its value.
limitations: Chromium only; touch uses CDP emulation rather than physical hardware.
Clipboard tests explicitly inject API results; real clipboard permission was not tested.
Hidden-document handling uses injected document.hidden and visibilitychange in a real browser; actual operating-system backgrounding was not tested.
NaN-like number input is browser-normalized to blank, and rejection is verified after that normalization.
No physical pen device or screen-reader test was performed.
accessibilityReview: RAF metrics use plain strong text and transport state plain p; only action/error/completion status is aria-live polite. No output implicit live region.
